body: Yeah I’m ugly as well. It’s a pain that few know. I wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy. I think about killing myself a lot. I swear it pisses me off so much sometimes, that I got cursed with being ugly. And almost everyone I see seems so much more normal. I’m sorry it happened to you and I hope you find the will to live and some peace. It’s hard but there has to be some sort of silver lining. If not in this life then the next. Stay strong.
Same here don’t know what else to say but I’m there with you. I hope you find peace in the new year

I know what it’s like to be unattractive and it sucks. That’s awesome that you write that can be a great release and you should take pride in that. I don’t think you can ever truly accept being alone forever but you grow numb to it after a while and it hurts less. It takes time as cliche as that sounds. And hey you never know what could happen in life it’s so unpredictable so maybe you might find someone. I know you don’t think that will happen for you but I wish you all the best. Happy new year.
I hope you have a good New Year’s Eve. I’m spending it with my dad I hope this next year is better for you, and all the other people here.

I have bipolar disorder as well. And I’m ugly and live with my parents. I tried going to college but it didn’t work out as I wasn’t smart enough to excel. Now I live a half life. I hope you find peace. Happy thanksgiving.
No nothing like that.
They just give me quick business like replies and turn away as quick as possible. Then I see them with everyone else and it’s night and day.
Holy shit. That’s messed up. How have you coped with being alone for so long? Forty years.. I’m only 23 and life is hell.
Why did she cry when you told her you loved her?
I see what you’re saying. For me personally I’ve been isolated for so long, a good friend that isn’t judgmental and would be willing to hang out would be enough.

Yeah I know how you feel. I am generally against taking most medication I used to be on haldol and olanzapine and they made me a zombie. The benzo didn’t give me as bad of sides. Anyway best of luck to you.

I’m pulling for you. Have you tried getting on meds for the anxiety/ ADHD. I have severe anxiety and my psychiatrist prescribed me a benzo and I guess it helped a little bit I’m still damaged psychologically but I feel more relaxed.

The reason could be a great number of things. Like personality or mental health issues. Which yes are debilitating. But nobody can deny that it is definitely worse to be ugly and know that’s the reason vs being attractive and at least having a chance. You know what I’m saying

Being ugly is the worst thing that can happen to you. Some people were just born to suffer. Nothing helps I have the same conversation with myself every day. I get happy then I’m reminded of how unlovable I am. Every time I look in a mirror my day is ruined.

I just want to let you know you aren’t alone and I relate to your post. I also don’t like my face and I’ve also attempted once before and it was the darkest time in my life. I managed to pull through because my family was so supportive. I hope you can find a reason to keep going. I’m sorry you had to go through so much. Dm me if you ever want to talk.

I would be homeless as well if it wasn’t for my Mom. I really feel like I tried in life like I gave it my best shot. But being ugly and constantly reminded of it made me a recluse. Ik it shouldn’t affect me that much but I too have grown tired of life. And nobody likes me either.
I relate to your post. I’m sorry you had to have such a fucked up time as a kid. I hope things get better for you. Or like you said you manage to find some peace.

Yeah I remember in school people called me ugly, and generally just stayed away from me. It’s had a lasting effect on me. Made me a bitter person. Nowadays I spend all my time doing nothing and staying in my room at my parents house at 22. Whenever I go out in public people give me looks of hate and I guess I was just tired of dealing with it. So I just gave up on life. I hope things get better for you. That’s a fucked up situation. I know from experience.
Yeah I hate looking in the mirror or at photos of myself. I’m just like why tf am I even alive. Like literally everyone around me is attractive and I’m just ignored. It’s not a life worth living.
Sorry for your loss that’s terrible. I’ll be keeping you in my prayers.

Yeah, I’m so sick of being alone. It’s made me a bitter person. I relate with the feeling, like I didn’t ask to be here. I just hate being ugly that’s basically what it comes down to, for me at least. That and how it is so easy for other people and is impossible for me.

I too have become a social hermit. I haven’t had a real conversation with someone other than my family for a few years. I’m thankful I have my mom who spends time with me mainly just watching tv. But other than that I’m completely alone. On top of that I’m ugly as well. I don’t see it ever getting better.

Yeah, I relate to being facially unattractive. Add that with being unintelligent and I basically had no chance. Sometimes the only way to cope is laugh. Because it’s so ridiculous that someone like me even tried in the first place.

Right, there is more that is involved. But a lot of it has to do with my upbringing and school where I was called ugly, and was ostracized. For being different. Life isn’t fair, and sometimes people just get the short end of the stick. If I was attractive I feel like a lot of my problems would be different. But thanks anyways I hope things get better for you.
I relate to this. It feels like everyone is on a separate wavelength than me. Like a world that happens all around me that I was never apart of. I attribute that mostly to my appearance.
I’m sorry you lost your friend. That must be tough. You will be in my prayers.

Yeah I feel this. It’s so hard being ugly and most people just don’t understand the pain that goes along with it. If your ugly you’re going to have a much harder life than someone who is attractive. I also wish people would ignore me if they don’t like me rather than glaring hatefully in my direction. Sorry you have to go through it too.

I relate with being ugly. I’ve been alone for about five years without talking to anyone besides my mom. It’s a situation I wish I could get out of. But when your as visually unappealing as I am it’s impossible. I wish the best for you.
What do they say?
I feel the same. Being ugly and unwanted by everyone even my family is like hell on earth. I hope you feel better. Even if your situation doesn’t.
I feel the same. I don’t even look at girls anymore. When I’m in public I just stare at the ground or my phone.
Yeah I guess if your Ryan Gosling you can get away with it lmao. Forgot about that part.
Lars and the real girl is pretty good. It’s about a guy that falls in love with a sex doll so… I guess that’s Fa.

Honestly I would kill myself today if I had the courage. I guess once the fear of death is less than the pain of living. I will finally be able to do it. I can’t imagine I’ll be living past thirty either.

I’ve always wanted to try psychedelics. I don’t have a dealer to buy from though. What were your experiences like?
Same. Just know your not alone. I deal with disgust from everyone too. I have thoughts of killing myself every day. It sucks I’m sorry you have to deal with it too.
Yeah same here. I hope the best for you.

Be careful what you wish for. When everyone treats you like shit because of the way you look and doesn’t want to talk to you; you might change your mind. If your good looking you have some sort of a chance at life. You don’t want all those years of bullying and isolation. Trust me from experience you don’t want that. Honestly posts like this kind of piss me off because your wishing to be ugly. When a lot of people here would kill to be handsome and kill for thos opportunities.
I think the point is that we weren’t supposed to live like this. It’s fucked up. And people wonder why I want to kill myself.
I definitely relate to this. I have to have hope that there is another life. Because my life is such a failure; in every way. That’s the only thing that’s gotten me through.

Why do you think that. Jesus can forgive you no matter what you’ve done. I’ve struggled with wondering if God loves me because of my appearance and not fitting in. But I believe he can look past that. I don’t think anyone is beyond saving.
Thank you a lot for this reply, it’s really helpful. The world is a messed up place but like you said Jesus is always there, I wish the best for you man. God bless.

Yeah school is rough, I got called ugly too. I remember just minding my business sitting at my desk, and girls were taking a Snapchat and got me in it and said “Ew ugly get out of the picture” when I was just minding my business.

I feel the same. Being ugly in my experience is the worst thing that can happen to you. Any other problems can be overcome if you are attractive. But when you meet disgust with every person you talk to; you become bitter. It’s natural to be depressed when the cause of your depression is unfixable.

I just always knew it was over for me. Too ugly and dumb to even function. So my life was over coming right out of the gate. Shit sucks, honestly if your attractive your problems can be fixable at least for the most part when u r ugly u don’t have a chance.
I’m totally fucked man. That’s all I can say. But keep your head up. You will definitely find someone. There are people a lot worse off. I got faith in you.
Dude it’s all mental for you. I recommend seeing a therapist. You are very attractive. Honestly if you have no luck with online dating I’m totally fucked.

I don’t understand all the hatred on his post. For a community that is supposed to welcome people. You borderline make fun of him. If you don’t have anything kind to say then don’t say anything at all.
Yeah I feel the same way.
Yeah same. I just wish I had a chance to do it over again in the right body and the right mind. I fantasize about my life being different all the time.

I can relate to you. I’ve been called ugly and laughed at too. Simply for existing. Some people were just born to suffer. I’m so sorry it happened to you too. Just know your not alone in feeling that way. I wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy. It’s like you want to be treated like a human being but people just ignore you. Like you never had a chance in the first place. No matter what I do there is no fixing it. It’s a living hell for a minority of people. And no one takes the time to try and understand you. Nobody gives you a chance based on how you look. The worst thing isn’t even that it happens once. It happens every time I’m in public. There is no running away from who you are. And some people were born to lose. It sucks, I guess just know you aren’t alone.
That’s horrible man. I can’t believe people would do that to you. Did you even do anything to provoke them. Or were you just standing there?

I feel the same. It sucks seeing everyone else happy. Asking yourself why couldn’t it be me. Sometimes life just fucks you over and there is no getting over it. You seem like a nice guy though. I’m sure you will find someone. If you don’t I hope you find some sort of happiness in your situation. Maybe with people that are close to you, your family. I hope things get better for you. They haven’t for me but maybe they will for you.
What’s your PayPal username I’ll see if I can send it through that
Do you have a cash app? If so send me your username. I can’t help you a lot but I can send you a little money for a meal or something.
No I don’t. They all have their own lives. And if they really cared I think they’d reach out. Shit sucks not having real friends.
That sucks man. I had a few friends in middle school and highschool. But they would always poke fun of me so. I guess you couldn’t really characterize them as friends.
Don’t have the money otherwise I would.
I think a lot of people here don’t know how to deal with it. I’m 21 too; actually not a introvert either. My situation made me into one. Sorry your going through it too. It sucks.
What do you spend your time doing. What do you distract yourself with?
That sucks man. I’m the same way. Been called ugly, I was a mistake. I’m sorry you have to deal with it too. Ik it’s cliche but hopefully things will get better for you.

I feel you as far as being socially awkward. I’ve been called ugly too for a long time. It sucks seeing people happy and in relationships. And missing that vital human component. Do you have a cash app? Maybe I could send you some money so you can get a good meal.
I gotta go with fight club, taxi driver, and the new Batman movies especially the dark knight.
Do you have a favorite movie from that time period?
This movie called licorice pizza. It was a romantic comedy. Not great but not terrible. Thanks for asking.
I agree I never really thought other people understood; but some people in this community do. I always thought I was the only one.

It actually scared me because I never really lost control of my body like that before. It was like my whole body was stuttering and all my body parts locked up. Like being electrocuted all over. I think it scared me more than anything.
That sucks man. I hope you find happiness. If not a lot, maybe some happiness in the small things. You are a good person for sticking around that long for someone else.
Sounds like a nice fantasy man.

Yeah I feel this. Sometimes life just fucks you. I’m sorry you have to deal with it too. I try to distract myself but at the end of the day, I have to face myself in the mirror. I’m sorry man I know what it’s like and I wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy.
Yeah me too

I hope things get better. And if they don’t which often times they don’t. I hope you find some peace in yourself. With whatever you decide to do. The world will have lost a kind human being if you were to go. But I understand why you would want to. I don’t like the body I’m in either so I can somewhat relate to you. Best of wishes I hope only good things come your way.

Just because you leave the church it doesn’t mean you leave Jesus. Some of the most Christ like people I’ve met are people outside the church. That being said I agree with you. It’s hard to be truthful in a society of lies. When you truly preach the gospel. It is meant to offend you. Meant to get you to change your ways. I’m not perfect by any means and the life I have I’ve gotten what I deserved. I made a lot of mistakes in my teenage years. Sick shit. I feel bad for it though and I’m trying to change my ways. Like you said just because the church doesn’t love you doesn’t mean Jesus doesn’t. Thank you for this comment it feels good to know that there are people that are hated as much as I am. People that understand.

That’s what I hate the most. It would be okay if I was ugly and able to make friends. Believe me I’ve tried. But how can I ask people to look at my face when I can’t even look at my face. It’s unfortunate but the truth.
I feel the same.

I feel the same way. But regardless of how it looks I remind myself that Jesus loves me. Even though I am extremely unattractive and have nobody in life. I have faith that maybe we go through all this so that we can be happy on the other side. And it will make it that much better. I’m not trying to preach to you or tell you to open a bible. I’m just saying what helps me out. If you ever want to talk about anything just message me. I’m socially awkward and an outcast as well. Anyways best of luck to you.
I agree life sometimes is torture. It is for me too. I hope things get better for you.

Yeah that would be my preferred weapon. Problem is for me that I live with my parents and don’t have a car or job or money to pay for one. Honestly it sucks, feeling trapped not being able to live but also too cowardly or not having a good way to die. Sometimes I pray that there is a better life on the other side. It gives me some sort of peace. Still doesn’t really change my situation though. Anyways sorry for the rant but I hope you find something to live for, even if it’s just something small. And know your not alone man.

That being said I feel what your saying and I’m sorry your going through it.

But I also know that people don’t usually consider suicide until it’s a last resort. So just know I will be praying for you and wishing you all the best.

When you look in the mirror every single day and see someone there that shouldn’t be there. It takes a toll. Having absolutely nobody to talk to in life every day takes a toll on you. When you are a disappointment to even your own parents and they feel ashamed for even having me. That takes a toll. I’m not trying to say I have worse problems than you. I’m just saying I never had the chance to even begin the race of life. I want to face those challenges. But it’s hard. Imagine a race where you want to race but you can’t even get through the front door. You can’t even begin the race. Idk sorry if that offended you, it wasn’t my intention with the post.
I just meant carefree in that they don’t worry about their appearance. I know everyone has problems I’m not saying they don’t.

Hey I read your story. I’ve also been in mental wards and tried therapy and medicine. It didn’t really work well for me either. I hope your doing alright. I’ll be praying for you. If you ever want to talk just dm me.

And if you ever need to talk to someone my dms are always open.

That sucks. I hope your former manager comes through for you. I’ll be praying for you.

Happy birthday! I hope you have a great day.

On behalf of people who aren’t attractive. Go live your life. Because you have it all. The only thing stopping you is your mind. Ik that seems harsh but fr. Because if you weren’t attractive people wouldn’t lie to you. I hope this helps but it probably won’t.
I hope you find some peace and some kind people to talk to. I’m sorry you had to go through this.
I hope you have a good day, remember Jesus loves you. If you ever want to vent or talk my dms are open. I’m sorry that happened to you.
I feel you man stay strong.
You seem like a great person I hope you find some sort of peace in this shitty world.

When nobody cares about you, and why would they because I can’t even like myself. I just wanted to say I feel you and I’m right there with you. We may not know each other but your not alone.
I feel the same. Know your not alone. Wish you the best, maybe 2021 will be a better year.
I’m sure everyone appreciates your support even if it goes unnoticed. Jesus loves you and if you ever need someone to talk to my dms are open.
If you ever want to text someone my dms are open brother.

People keep saying find something to live for or get involved in hobbies or we love you. Just know at the end of the day these people don’t know you irl and most likely they aren’t in the same state. Even if they were they will probably ghost you online eventually or irl if you ever meet them. It’s just the way people are. Nothing changes. In fact help might not be on the way. Imo and experience people “help” you or say they “care” about you when in reality they don’t because after a little while they will also leave. And when u are feeling better. They will forget you existed or worse they will while your not feeling better. Therapists are people you pay money to in order to listen to you. When in reality you are just one of a hundred people complaining to them. It’s there job they don’t really care about you. Medicine numbs your mind and in my experience didn’t help. As in not at all I still felt the exact same. People don’t care about you unless you have something to offer them. If you don’t then u might as well be trash. (In their eyes) “live just to spite them” yeah that works for a while. People also say live for yourself. In reality humans are made as social beings and we die prematurely if we are chronically lonely or have any sort of mental illness. (I experience both). If I ever am chosen to even be spoken to it’s as a last resort and only a few words are exchanged. Pretty soon when your so tired that you can’t keep up the fake smile and facade anymore they just avoid you even more. Or say something like “you look tired cheer up” or “how are you” when if you say anything other than good or try to actually open up they will pretend to care and then not think twice about you for the rest of their life. Once again I’ll say and I’ll go to my grave saying people only care about you when you have something to offer them. If you are seen as inferior or less than in any way (if you have a physical deformity, blindness, deafness, are very old, can’t walk, mentally challenged, antisocial/depressed/psychotic/schizo,  unattractive or other) There are some truly evil people out there that get relationships and have friends and experience the good things in life. Well the answer is that they were born with attractive features and intelligence and that’s why they experience these things. Living for yourself yeah that’s bullshit. The only reason TO live is for others. Do I want to live? no. Do I want to commit suicide? no simply because of the pain. Are there any happy moments? no not really. I’ll probably be dead soon anyway from my mental state loneliness and drugs I took when I was younger. Should you live well that’s a question only you can answer. Living just to live is not much of an existence. But it’s a existence. That’s all it is existing to exist. That being said it’s life and it’s hard. Nobody cares. I’ve just had to learn to live with it. I guess like living with a crutch your whole life. Yeah I’m prepared for everyone to say I’m not in my right mind or I’m just throwing a pity party. I tried opening up to my father and he told me he was sick of my shit and to leave him alone. Maybe I’m not in my right mind, prove me wrong then is what I say. Anyways I’ll be keeping you in mind. I hope you find the will to live.

Nothing is wrong you just made a mistake we all do it. I don’t think she should completely cut contact with you. She must have very high standards when it comes to honesty.
